summary: Tested Editable Promotions (public + admin CRUD/reorder/toggle/countdown/expiry) and SOC Live Classes (schedule, enquiry, rate limit, admin list/status/filters/CSV/settings) end-to-end. Backend 24/25 pass after 1 fix by testing agent; frontend landing + admin flows 100% working. Found and FIXED: '3+ years IT' experience always rejected (422) due to unescaped regex '+'. Remaining: enquiry returns 500 if message contains a phrase from the email safety scanner list (e.g. 'CVV'), even though the enquiry is already saved.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent: EnquiryIn.experience pattern had unescaped '+' in '3+ years IT', so it matched '3 years IT'/'33 years IT' but never the real dropdown value. Every visitor picking '3+ years IT' got 422. Changed it to '3\+ years IT' in routes_promo.py and verified through the UI.

Returns 500 when the user's message (or name) contains a phrase from core._CRED_ASK (e.g. 'Do I need to share my CVV for fee payment?'). The cause is that _assert_safe_email raises ValueError OUTSIDE send_email's try/except. The admin-copy email includes the message. The enquiry is already inserted and the visitor email already sent, so the user sees an error and retries, which creates duplicates and uses up the 5/day limit. Same risk if an admin sets demo_link to a host that _host_ok rejects (link shortener): every demo enquiry would 500. Fix: wrap both send_email calls in try/except (or move _assert_safe_email inside the try in core.send_email), and/or validate demo_link host on settings PUT.

minor.issue: ids list is not validated (unknown ids silently ignored; a partial list leaves duplicate order values).
Two emails are sent one after another inside the request (each with a 30s httpx timeout), so a slow provider can hold the response up to 60s. Consider BackgroundTasks.

integration_issues.issue: move(), del() and set() have no try/catch, so an API failure is an unhandled promise rejection with no toast.

issues: If an offer expires while the page is open, the card shows 'offer ended' until reload instead of hiding (only the server filters expired cards). Minor.

Optionally validate demo_link host with _host_ok in PUT /api/admin/live-classes/settings
Add try/catch + toast to AdminPromos move/del and AdminLive status set

send_email safety assertion runs outside the try block, so any user-supplied text can turn into a 500 on endpoints that put user input into emails
public_promos compares ends_at by ISO string. It works because both sides are UTC '+00:00' isoformat, but comparing datetimes would be safer
Tests must run with -n0 (sequential): the settings test changes demo_time, which invalidates session_at for enquiry tests running in parallel

rca of the issue: 1) Pydantic pattern '^(...|3+ years IT|...)$': '+' means 'one or more 3', so the literal '3+ years IT' does not match. Fixed with '3\+'. 2) core.send_email calls _assert_safe_email(subject, html) before its try block. The admin email html contains the user message, so 'cvv' etc. raises ValueError, giving an unhandled 500 after db insert. Reproduce: POST enquiry with message containing 'CVV'. Mitigate: put the assertion inside the try, or catch it in live_enquiry.
